main_idea: AfterQuery warmup raised Nemotron 3 Ultra’s GDPval score from 35.3 to 46.7.
ideas: Warmup leaves the model 2.8 points behind the teacher.
Nemotron 3 Ultra has about six times the throughput of comparable open models.
summary: The chart is clear, but two cards repeat its results and a third adds a separate throughput claim.
